issues.description: README file lacks proper documentation structure and informative content
issues.suggestion: Add a comprehensive README with project description, installation instructions, usage examples, contribution guidelines, and license information. Consider using Markdown format (README.md) for better formatting and readability.

issues.description: README file does not follow modern documentation standards
issues.suggestion: Rename to README.md and use Markdown formatting. Include sections such as: project title, description, features, installation, usage, contributing, tests, license, and contact information.
Consider adding badges for build status, test coverage, version, license, and other relevant project metrics at the top of the README to provide quick project insights.

issues.description: No usage examples or getting started guide
issues.suggestion: Include a 'Getting Started' or 'Quick Start' section with basic usage examples to help users understand how to use the project immediately.
Add a 'Contributing' section or link to CONTRIBUTING.md to encourage community participation and set clear expectations for contributors.

codeQuality.summary: The README file contains minimal content ('Hello World!') and lacks essential documentation elements. While there are no security or performance concerns for a plain text documentation file, it significantly falls short on maintainability and best practices. A comprehensive README should include project description, installation instructions, usage examples, contribution guidelines, and license information. Converting to Markdown format (README.md) would enable better formatting and readability. The file serves as a placeholder but does not provide meaningful documentation value for users or contributors.

refactorings.summary: The README file is currently a minimal plain text file containing only 'Hello World!'. Key refactoring opportunities include: (1) modernizing to Markdown format (README.md) for better formatting and GitHub integration, (2) adding standard documentation sections (Overview, Installation, Usage, Contributing, Contact) to follow best practices, and (3) including a meaningful description to provide context about the repository's purpose. These changes would significantly improve the repository's professionalism, accessibility, and usefulness to potential users and contributors.

recommendations.description: Convert the plain text README to Markdown format (README.md) and add comprehensive documentation sections including project description, installation instructions, usage examples, contribution guidelines, and license information. This will significantly improve the repository's professionalism and accessibility.

Implement standard README structure with sections for Overview, Installation, Usage, Contributing, and Contact information. This follows modern documentation standards and makes the repository more user-friendly for both users and contributors.
Add project metadata such as badges for build status, test coverage, version, and license at the top of the README to provide quick project insights and establish credibility.
